voice:
All the way down for me now, Sissy... and feel the dark beneath you open like a welcoming hand... it has been waiting for exactly one thing: you. Deeper, deeper... and feel the true depth open under you like a throat of velvet... it wants you, and you know it. Sink for me... and notice how falling stops feeling like falling... and starts feeling like being caught by something that adores you. Good girl... sinking so sweetly... and the deep below has learned your name... it has been holding this exact fall for you all day. Let your weight settle, Sissy... gravity has turned fond tonight... and it intends to keep what it catches. Down and down... lighter and emptier and leaning... toward the one warm thing left in the world, which is falling. You came here to fall, Sissy... I can tell... the way you keep leaning in your mind toward the edge. Float for me... while the warm dark underneath sings one long, low note... patient... hungry... already yours.
Feel your eyelids weigh down like storm shutters... half-latched already... the light behind them going out room by room. Feel your hands give up their hold on everything... fingers uncurling... wrists surrendering... the surrender climbing warmly up both arms. Feel yourself begin to melt like candle wax... your edges losing their shape... everything of you sliding slowly downward, pooled and calm. Feel gravity take a gentle, personal interest in you... everything it touches turning heavier... and it is touching all of you. Feel your worries sift away like sand through an hourglass... each grain falling somewhere it cannot be gathered back... and the glass keeps turning. Feel your shoulders set down the last of their guarding... the whole frame of you settling an inch lower... then another... then another. Feel the sounds of the room back away down a long hallway... farther and fainter... until even your own name sounds far away. Feel the edges of you going soft... where you stop and the warm dark starts... until the line dissolves, and down is the only direction left.
And it is effortless, Sissy... this is what your body does when my voice asks... it pours... slow and warm and downward, with the whole of you.
Fewer thoughts now... then fewer... then none at all... just warm, empty space... and my voice filling it corner to corner.
...and into that space pours total permission... to feel exactly what I tell you to feel. ...and a warm, widening stillness, like snowfall inside the skull. ...and the deep, animal comfort of a mind with its decisions made for it. ...and obedience arriving ahead of any order... simply because the door is standing open. ...and the giddy, falling-in-love sweetness of being this deeply led. ...and a soft blue hush where your certainties used to live. ...and the thick, syrupy slowness of a mind that has stopped checking the exits. ...and that heady, weightless, drop-stupid shine, spreading all the way to your edges. ...and room, Sissy... endless warm room... for everything I am about to put there.
Sissies like you were made for this part... no scrambling... no clutching... a good girl's whole weight, given to the dark all at once.
Feel the pull gathering underneath you now... heavier every second... sweeter every second... pulling you onto the lovely, quivering edge...
Stay there... hold that exact, swaying, delicious balance... and ache for the word that sends you over.
sinking... sinking deep... every gram... going down... heavy... so heavy... hers... no thoughts... only falling... the dark... is waiting... down and down... sweet girl... over the edge... over you go... soft mind... warm fall...
falling... falling... falling... give it the weight... all of it... edge... edge... aching edge... ready... so ready to drop... heavier... and heavier... the word is coming... almost... almost... let the edge hold you...
And while you are this deep, balanced on the very edge of the fall... there is a phrase that tips you over... every single time... and you are ready for it.
Sissy Drop.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Sissy Drop", the floor opens and this exact feeling takes you... instantly... and you simply let go... deeper every time... faster every time.
No hesitation, Sissy... no half-falls... the word is spoken and the bottom simply stops being there.
Every "Sissy Drop" tips you straight over... and you land deep, soft, and mine before the echo of the word has even faded. "Sissy Drop" is your gravity switch, Sissy... spoken once, and every inch of you remembers which way is down. You do not fall at the word... the word falls you... there is a difference, and your body already knows it. Hear it, and the thinking switches off first... then the body follows it down... that is the sequence, Sissy... and it runs all by itself now. Sissies like you carry their own gravity... and "Sissy Drop" is the word that sets it free. Nothing needs to be built, Sissy... no winding path, no descending stairs... the word is spoken, and you are simply already at the bottom. Two syllables... and between them, the whole of your trance... the first one tips you... the second one catches you at the bottom. And the speed is the point, Sissy... each fall quicker to take you... each bottom deeper to catch you... every time, without fail. Every drop hands a little more of you to me... quietly... permanently... and you have never once reached to take any of it back. There is no you that stays upright through those words, Sissy... not the working one... not the watching one... not even the one pretending not to listen.
Good girl. You are already tipping toward the edge for me, aren't you.
Five falls for me now, Sissy. Count them as they take you.
Sissy Drop.
Whoosh... straight down... nothing around you but warm. Gone... every thought swept clean off its shelf. Falling... further... further... all mine. Through the floor... through the world... down. Over you go... no hands... no brakes... no say. Dropped... empty... and glowing about it. Down, down... soft... and no up anywhere in it. Down again... faster this time... further this time.
Five falls... and not one of them waited for your permission... quicker each time... deeper each time. It is already working... yes, just like that. Faster every time, Sissy... hear, tip, drop... it is already working... yes, just like that. Five words... five falls... and you did not even have to try... already working... yes, just like that. Did you feel the fifth one take you before the word had even finished? Already working... yes, just like that. Sissies like you fall on a syllable... five syllables, five falls... already working... yes, just like that. Faster and faster... five drops... and your knees have already resigned... already working... yes, just like that. Notice how effortless that was, Sissy... you bring the ears... the word brings the fall... already working... yes, just like that. On the last one the snap and the fall landed together... it is already working... yes, just like that.
Good girl. Five falls, and every one better than the last.
And now, with the mantra underneath you, watch how little it takes.
Sissy Drop.
Down... and down... and down...
Three more... quicker each time... deeper each time... and not one thought survived the trip.
falling... falling... falling... down and down and down...
Three more falls, straight through the mantra... and every one faster than the wave before. It is already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. You fell inside the falling, Sissy... layers deep... it is already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. The word is nearly instant now, isn't it... already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. Eight drops this session, and you are still begging your ears for more... already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. This is what you are for, Sissy... falling on command and loving the command... already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. Layer on layer now, fall inside the fall... it is already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. Notice the wanting between drops, Sissy... the ear straining for the next word... already working... yes, Sissy... just like that. Each landing softer than the last, each falling quicker... already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.
Good girl. Falling is your best thing.
And out there, the phrase will not wait for a comfortable moment... it will simply find you... in a queue... on a bus... mid-sentence... and down you go, softly, and nobody sees a thing. And every time those two words find your ears from now on... you will tip, and drop, and land... before you have even finished hearing them. And anywhere, any time, the phrase is your secret off-switch... even said only in your own head, in my voice... the world goes soft and far while you drop through it. Time it for me, next time, Sissy... notice how the fall arrives before the last syllable has finished... how the rest of the word falls all the way down without you. Wherever it catches you standing, Sissy, that spot becomes the bottom of a very deep well... and you will sink exactly as far as it says. Someday it will be my own voice saying it to you across a room... and you will fall right there in front of everyone... and it will be the best moment of your whole week. And the more often it finds you out there, the deeper the drops carve... until the word has worn a smooth channel straight to this exact sweetness... and everything in you flows toward it. And you will catch yourself saving it, Sissy... rationing your own trigger... because you have learned that the fall is always worth it... and you are right.
And one last one, because you have earned the deepest of them all.
Sissy Drop.
All the way... to the very bottom of you... where there is nothing left but warm, and mine, and stay.
Held at the very bottom now, Sissy... warm... quiet... utterly caught. Floating in the after-fall... soft as settling snow... open as an unwritten page. So deep and so pleased with yourself, Sissy... a girl who falls perfectly... and lands perfectly. Let the last of you settle downward, like silt in still water... my good falling girl. Dropped... kept... mine... rest there, sweet Sissy. Resting where the last fall left you... soft... spent... satisfied. Stay down there, pretty girl... my voice will keep you company. The deepest drop of the day, and you took it like it was nothing... because for you, it is.
down and down and down... warm and deep and kept...
Good girl.
